notes: RECLASSIFIED from an initial PASS after re-reading the raw response: HTTP 200 with {checked_in:false, status:"free", reservation_code:null} is the JS-correct SHAPE (apps/customer/js/features/checkin.js:112,121 explicitly branches on checked_in===false as a *failure* state — "table found but no active reservation on it"), so the request/response wiring is proven, but the state-changing success path (Table.state->occupied, Reservation.update, ReservationEvent per the plan) was NOT exercised. Root cause: every same-day availability slot for a brand-new reservation is necessarily in the future (you cannot book the past), and the checkin window only opens 30 minutes before slotStart — so a script that books 'the nearest available slot' and immediately tries to check in can structurally never land inside that window (observed gap: 54 minutes short). This is a real reservation-system property (minimum lead time between booking and slot), not a reproduction of a product defect, but it means the true happy path (checked_in:true) remains UNPROVEN by this harness.
